steps.name: Sample structure QC: library sizes, PCA, sample distances, low-depth sample verdict
caveats: A library size far below the median is handled by DESeq2's per-sample size factor in downstream count models; a depth difference alone is not evidence of a bad sample and must not drive an automatic removal decision (R-0008, R-0030)

With only 6 samples per group, the sample distance heatmap and PCA are the primary tools for detecting an outlier — treat any exclusion recommendation as provisional and state the reasoning explicitly rather than as a default action
12000 genes and 12 samples is small enough that this step runs comfortably in memory; no batch variable exists in the metadata (single batch) so no batch coloring is applicable

This step's verdict is descriptive/QC only — it does not itself decide whether sample_01 will be included in a later differential expression analysis; that decision, if made, should be documented as a stated judgment call
steps.context: Input: /eval-sonnet-plane-r2-with-qc-only-n6-2/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv (12000 genes x 12 samples, raw integer salmon-derived gene counts) and /eval-sonnet-plane-r2-with-qc-only-n6-2/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (12 samples x condition: AD lesional vs control). Single batch, unpaired 6v6 design. Flagged caveat: sample_01 library size ~4x below study median.
steps.question: Across the 12 skin samples (6 AD lesional vs 6 control), what are the per-sample library sizes and detected gene counts, how do samples separate on a PCA of variance-stabilized counts, what do the sample-to-sample Euclidean distances show, and does sample_01 (flagged at ~4x below median library size) look like an outlier that warrants exclusion or can it be retained for downstream analysis?

grounding.reason: R-0033 mandates sample structure QC (blind VST, PCA on top-500 variable genes, Euclidean sample-distance heatmap, colored by condition) before any modeling; R-0008 mandates keeping/inspecting/reporting a sample with library size far below median rather than silently dropping it, with removal only for a stated reason.

constraints: Use DESeq2::varianceStabilizingTransformation with blind=TRUE (do not use the design-aware VST) so the QC is independent of the condition model
Compute PCA on the 500 genes with highest variance across samples per the grounded default (n_top_genes=500)
Do not drop or downweight sample_01 before or during this QC step; it must appear in every plot and table
Do not perform any differential expression testing, hypothesis testing, or gene filtering beyond what DESeq2's internal size-factor estimation requires for VST
Color/annotate all plots by condition (AD lesional vs control); label sample_01 individually in the PCA and distance plots
acceptance_criteria: Reports raw library size (total counts) and number of detected genes (count>0) per sample, ranked, with sample_01 explicitly annotated and its fold-difference from the median library size stated
Produces a PCA plot (PC1 vs PC2, and variance explained) on blind VST-transformed counts using the top 500 most variable genes, colored by condition (AD lesional vs control), with sample_01 labeled
Produces a sample-to-sample Euclidean distance heatmap/matrix on the blind VST data, samples ordered/annotated by condition, with sample_01's distances to all other samples reported

States a clear, evidence-based verdict on sample_01: whether it clusters with its assigned condition group, whether its distances to other samples are anomalous, and an explicit keep/flag/remove recommendation with the stated reason per R-0008 (depth alone is not sufficient grounds for removal)
All outputs (library size table, PCA plot, distance heatmap) and the verdict are saved together as a QC report

plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin RNA-seq: sample QC
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 12 bulk RNA-seq samples (6 AD lesional, 6 control skin, salmon-quantified raw gene counts, 12000 genes) with one flagged caveat: sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median. Before any differential testing, the question asks only for descriptive sample structure QC: library sizes, PCA, sample-to-sample distances, and a judgment on the shallow sample. Per the grounded QC procedure (R-0033, R-0008), we load counts and metadata into DESeq2, compute raw library sizes and detected-gene counts per sample, apply a blind variance-stabilizing transformation, run PCA on the top 500 most variable genes, and compute a Euclidean sample-distance heatmap, coloring by condition throughout. Sample_01 is kept through this QC and evaluated on library size, detected genes, its PCA position, and its distance to other samples — not dropped by depth alone (R-0008/R-0030) — with removal only recommended if it demonstrably falls outside the sample-to-sample structure of its group with a stated reason. This is a single self-contained QC step; no DE testing, filtering, or enrichment is asked for or performed.

steps.method: DESeq2 vst(blind) + PCA + sample distance heatmap + library size barplot
